source.name: Farmers Exchange
source.notes: Classic downtown lofts. Upfront includes $75 app fee (excludes deposit). Monthly includes $30 flat fee for water/trash.

source.name: Georgia Heights
source.notes: Luxury downtown high-rise above Target. Upfront includes $35 app and $150 admin fee. Base rent includes furnishings and internet.

source.name: Hub Athens
source.notes: Luxury high-rise located downtown. Extremely walkable but high parking premiums. Starting monthly price is $1,099 plus fees. $5 monthly tech fee is represented in mandatory fees. $50 application fee and $150 administrative fee are represented in upfront costs. A required $68.40 annual Conservice fee is published. Parking starts at $175/month and is optional.

source.name: Rambler Athens
source.notes: Fees updated. Upfront includes $200 admin, $50 app, $79.20 utility setup (excludes $100 refundable deposit). Monthly includes $5 trash fee.

source.name: The Mark Athens
source.notes: Luxury high-rise located downtown. Extremely walkable but high parking premiums. Starting inclusive monthly installment per person/per bed. Base price is $999/month. Inclusive installment includes mandatory monthly fees. Optional premiums and one-time charges are excluded.

source.name: The Standard
source.notes: Luxury high-rise located downtown. Extremely walkable but high parking premiums. Base rate shown. Mandatory fees include internet/trash. Parking is optional.

source.name: Uncommon Athens
source.notes: Upfront includes $50 app and $150 admin fee. Secure parking available for roughly $65/mo.

source.name: Uncommon Athens
source.notes: Upfront includes $50 app and $150 admin fee.

source.name: 1785 Club
source.notes: Fees updated. Upfront includes $200 admin, $100 app, $110 tech fee. Monthly includes $6 billing, $16 insurance.

source.name: Accolade Athens
source.notes: Purpose-built student community typically requiring a shuttle or drive to campus. Base rent. Upfront costs include $150 admin and $50 application fee. No mandatory monthly fees listed.

source.name: Athens Ridge
source.notes: Famous for lazy river. Upfront and mandatory fees not explicitly listed, typically requires utilities and insurance.

source.name: Bulldog Crossing
source.notes: Purpose-built student community typically requiring a shuttle or drive to campus. Upfront includes $250 admin fee.

source.name: Cambridge Apartments
source.notes: Purpose-built student community typically requiring a shuttle or drive to campus.

source.name: Campus Crossings Abbey West
source.notes: Fees updated. Monthly includes $18 landlord required insurance. Upfront fees unknown. Upfront includes $50 app fee.

source.name: Enclave 425
source.notes: Fees updated. Upfront includes $150 admin, $60 app. Monthly includes $15.75 damage waiver.

source.name: Flats at Carrs Hill
source.notes: Purpose-built student community typically requiring a shuttle or drive to campus. Surface lot parking is $45/mo.

source.name: Ikon at Athens
source.notes: Upfront includes ~$16 app, ~$33 admin, and $150 signing fee (often waived with specials).

source.name: Lark Athens
source.notes: Purpose-built student community typically requiring a shuttle or drive to campus. Typical base rate for 4x4. Utilities billed via conservice.

source.name: Polo Club Athens
source.notes: Upfront includes $50 app fee and $150 lease fee.

source.name: Polo Club Athens
source.notes: Upfront includes $50 app fee and $150 lease fee.

source.name: River Club Athens
source.notes: Purpose-built student community typically requiring a shuttle or drive to campus. Starting monthly installment. Water, sewer, trash, furniture, parking, and amenities are included. Contract may be paid in 12 equal monthly installments.

source.name: Riverbend Club
source.notes: Fees updated. Upfront includes $25 app/admin fee.

source.name: The Connection at Athens
source.notes: Utilities (water, trash, pest, cable, internet) included in base rent. Upfront app/admin fees vary. Upfront costs estimated at $200.

source.name: The Haven of Athens
source.notes: Monthly includes $12 valet trash, $13.50 damage waiver. Upfront includes $30 parking registration.

source.name: The Lodge of Athens
source.notes: Upfront includes $150 admin, $50 app, $150 telecom, $35 restoration (excludes $150 refundable deposit). Monthly includes $8.95 credit reporting, $17 insurance.

source.name: The Redland
source.notes: Monthly includes $10 Fetch package, $13.50 damage waiver, $6 valet trash, and $5.50 billing admin fee.

source.name: The Redland
source.notes: Monthly includes $10 Fetch package, $13.50 damage waiver, $6 valet trash, and $5.50 billing admin fee.

source.name: Towne Club
source.notes: Purpose-built student community typically requiring a shuttle or drive to campus. Price per person.

source.name: Woodsong Village
source.notes: Purpose-built student community typically requiring a shuttle or drive to campus. Starting inclusive monthly installment per person/per bed. Base price is $650.00/month. Published starting price includes all mandatory monthly fees, optional and one-time charges are not included.
